The '''Joroshe's Spirit Cave''' was a cave located in the [[Shattered Basin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. A holy site to the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], the cave was visited by [[Darth Silthar]], who was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in his search for answers about what the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] had discovered in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]].<ref name="TOR:JiD" />
